pn_convention.name: Pierre Villars Mendeleev Periodic Number (PN)
pn_convention.citation: Villars et al., Chem. Met. Alloys 2008; Oran et al., PNcsp+ JCTC 2026

valence_electron_definitions.valence_electrons: Follows the convention implemented by mendeleev 1.2.0 (Element.nvalence())
valence_electron_definitions.subshell_valence_counts: Derived from electronic configuration using project active-valence rule (closed 4f14/d10 cores treated as non-valence)
valence_electron_definitions.methodology_note: These definitions are library- and methodology-specific and must not be presented as a universal IUPAC definition.

data_provenance.pymatgen_data_provenance: pymatgen Element database value (used for allotropic species melting_point and thermal_conductivity)

imputation_policy.pauling_electronegativity: Undefined values for He, Ne, Ar are preserved strictly as NaN (not imputed, not zero)
imputation_policy.atomic_radius_slater: Linear regression on covalent_radius_cordero for Kr, Xe, At, Rn, Fr (imputed_atomic_radius = True)
imputation_policy.thermal_conductivity: Group 1 trend extrapolation for Fr (15.0 W/(m*K), imputed_thermal_conductivity = True)
